title: Turkish-Style Roasted Eggplant
description: A flavorful and vegan-friendly twist on traditional Turkish eggplant dishes. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner or as a side dish for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the eggplant, followed by the lemon juice, garlic, smoked paprika, and salt. Toss to coat evenly.
Bake the eggplant for 30-40 minutes, or until tender and lightly charred.
Remove the eggplant from the oven and let it cool slightly. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
